Regularly engage with Positive Subliminal Affirmations and Binaural Isochronic Tones to refine your abilities and propel you toward your goals.

Scientific research supports the use of positive subliminal audios as an effective way to rewire your subconscious mind—the core of your inner energy. This approach is an excellent aid for reaching your personal aspirations. In addition, binaural isochronic tones help transition your brain into an alpha state, enhancing its receptivity to the subliminal cues.

Dedicate at least 30 minutes a day, for a minimum of 21 days, to listening to our subliminal audio with headphones. Whether you are doing homework, walking, performing chores, or working out, you can easily incorporate these sessions into your routine.

Some even choose to play Shamanicca subliminals’ content while sleeping to boost their progress further. For optimal impact, try to enter a meditative state as you listen and picture your dream goal as if it has already been accomplished—intensifying the emotions associated with success.

Remember that results may differ from one individual to another, with some noticing changes sooner than others. It is also recommended to stay well-hydrated by drinking plenty of water.

Subliminals Benefits:

  • Boost self-love and acceptance.
  • Enhance confidence and happiness.
  • Cultivate attractiveness and magnetism.
  • Attract healthy love connections naturally.
  • Manifest ideal partnership.
  • Open up to fulfilling relationships.

Positive affirmations in Shamanicca’s subliminals audios:

  • I immensely love myself.
  • I accept myself.
  • I am confident.
  • I am happy.
  • I am strong and healthy.
  • I always attract healthy love connections.
  • I am loved by my ideal partner.
  • I attract my perfect match.
  • I possess ideal qualities.
  • I attract outstanding partners.
  • I set healthy boundaries naturally.
  • My perfect complement comes to me.
  • I express genuine love.
  • I forgive and move forward.
  • I understand others completely.
